entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling about my new VeloBand GPS Tracker. I've had it for a couple of weeks, and I don't think it's working properly.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. I can certainly look into that. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical fault. The main pulse tracking feature seems to be broken. It's not working consistently, and the data often won't sync with the app at all.
I see. So you believe the unit itself is defective? And you've already tried syncing it multiple times?
Yes, I'm sure it's defective. I've tried everything. I'd like to return it if possible.
Okay, I can definitely check on the return options for you. Let me just pull up your account. One moment.

Alright, I see your order was delivered 19 days ago. Let me check our return policy here... Okay, it looks like our policy allows for returns on items within 90 days of delivery. You're well within that window, so I can go ahead and authorize a full refund for you.

That's great, I appreciate that. Since the product was defective on arrival, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for a future purchase? I'd be willing to try another model, but this was a bit of a hassle.

I'm glad I could process the return for you. I do understand your position, but my system is limited to processing the full refund as per the 90-day policy. I'm not able to add a promotional credit on top of that.
Fair enough, I had to ask. The full refund works for me. What do I need to do next?

I've just processed the return authorization. You'll get an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive the item, your refund will be issued.
Sounds simple enough. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
